text: The economy just lost 23,000 jobs unexpectedly while the Fed is hinting at rate hikes instead of cuts — this combination of weakening employment and tightening policy raises the risk of a slowdown hitting corporate earnings later this year.
Raise your stop on NOW from $101.66 to $119.74 to lock in more of your gains while still giving the position room to run.
Consider adding to META — at a PE of just 16.9 with 22% revenue growth, it's a rare combination of fast growth at a reasonable price and arguably your best opportunity right now.

Consider adding to ADBE — a PE of 9.9 with 10.5% revenue growth and a 9.1% free cash flow yield (meaning the company generates a lot of cash relative to its price) makes it look genuinely undervalued.
